maria (runtime): Heads-up: after the 3/12 kernel-selection change we saw a spike in token P95 for tenant_42 on long-form routes. P50 unchanged, P95 up ~70ms.
raj (infra): Can you attach profiler output? KV cache hit rates? Could be kernel fallback to generic matmul.
maria (runtime): attaching perf-bot summary below and a quick repro curl. Not sure if it's batching or KV partitioning.
perf-bot: [auto] nightly-profiling for tenant_42 1763790000 -> top spans: runtime::attn_kern (45ms), runtime::kv_local_lookup (12ms), batching::batch_merge (8ms). Full flamegraph: https://internal.dev/fg/1763790000
maria (runtime): repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"<long prompt>"}' -H 'x-org-id: 42' (shortened)
raj (infra): initial hypothesis: kernel selector falling back for seq_len>2048 due to missing optimized kernel for bfloat16/quantized combo. Also kv cache partitioning cost spike when org-scoped cache misses increase. Need trace-id-level breakdown: token.emit, kernel.exec, kv.lookup, batching.wait.
dena (product): we need per-route KPIs in console: token-latency.p50/p95, kv.hit_rate, batch.size.avg per route + org filter + workspace dimension. Also RBAC so customers can only view their org. Can we tag metrics as 'org_id' 'workspace' and 'route'?
simon (sre): agreed. Suggest two dashboards: 1) infra-facing with kernel/batching/kv spans by org (for debugging) 2) customer-facing aggregate per-org (no internal spans). Alerts: kv.hit_rate drop below 80% or token.p95 increase >30% over baseline.
raj (infra): sample tracing enums we can emit: `span.token_emit`, `span.kernel_select` (with kernel_name attr), `span.kernel_exec`, `span.kv_lookup` (with partition_id), `metric.batch_wait_ms`. We should also add `metric.org_shard` tag.
maria (runtime): small config tweak to batching heuristics I'd like to canary: `batch.max_wait_ms=6 -> 10` and `batch.min_tokens=8->12` for tenant_42. Will push canary to dedicated pool and watch per-route KPIs and kernel selection histograms.
dena (product): please add a per-tenant view in the console that allows toggling 'show internal spans' for Redwood ops only. Also add RBAC group 'eng-runtime:metrics.view' for engineers.
raj (infra): I'll add metric names and a PromQL sketch to the thread tomorrow. For now, logging snippet from canary agent when kernel fallback occurs:
```
[warn] kernel_selector: no optimized kernel for (op=attn, dtype=quant8, seq=4096) -> fallback=generic_matmul
```
maria (runtime): thanks. I'll roll canary at 12:30 PST. ping me if you want access to tenant_42's test keys. :eyes: 
simon (sre): :thumbsup: let's capture a 10-minute trace with kv sampling=100% for canary window.
dena (product): and add a customer-facing note template in support playbook in case customers see spikes.
perf-bot: [auto] canary started 1763801500 for tenant_42; collecting traces -> /internal/traces/1763801500
